rubric_mapping.A1_Product_Choice_and_Domain: QCloud circuits compute fidelity similarity -> SVM Platt scaling gives P(active) and sigma. Opt QUBO/HUBO selects diverse, cost-bounded leads. Gate 3 ablation demonstrates 564 changed molecules when replaced by RBF.
rubric_mapping.A2_QCloud_Correctness: 8-qubit ZZ/angle feature map, exact simulator statevector overlap, finite-shot shot-noise bound sqrt(k*(1-k)/M), positive semi-definiteness & concentration variance logged.
rubric_mapping.A3_Opt_Correctness: Native cubic HUBO scaffold penalty, strict cardinality penalty A*(sum x - k)^2, global optimum proven by Brute Force check on all 19,600 combinations (gap=0.0000).
rubric_mapping.A4_Reproducibility: Strict zero-overlap scaffold split, automated tests (scaffold_overlap, no_label_leak, qpiai_invoked), single-command reproduction.

written_validation_plan.primary_assay: ALDH1 NADH fluorescence assay (AID 1030 replicate, excitation 340nm / emission 460nm)
written_validation_plan.orthogonal_assay: LC-MS substrate consumption assay (4-nitrobenzaldehyde to 4-nitrobenzoic acid)
written_validation_plan.counter_screening: ALDH2 isozyme selectivity counter-screen to establish ALDH1 target specificity
written_validation_plan.ic50_determination: 10-point 3-fold serial dilution (top concentration 50 uM, duplicate wells)
written_validation_plan.solubility_check: Nephelometric turbidity assay in 1% DMSO / aqueous assay buffer
written_validation_plan.go_threshold: IC50 <= 10 uM with >= 50% max inhibition -> GO (advance); IC50 > 50 uM -> DROP
written_validation_plan.selectivity_gate: ALDH2 IC50 / ALDH1 IC50 >= 10x -> GO (prevents toxic acetaldehyde accumulation)
written_validation_plan.solubility_gate: Turbidity < 10 NTU at 50 uM in 1% DMSO aqueous buffer -> GO
written_validation_plan.stopping_rule: If Lead 1 shows < 20% inhibition or precipitation > 10 NTU, advance Lead 2
